name: Get a pass installation URL for a contact
intent: Get a pass installation URL for a contact
description: Generate a wallet installation URL for a specific contact. The returned URL points to the pass installation page and encodes the pass, contact and organization identifiers as an encrypted token, so it can be shared with the contact (email, SMS, QR code, ...) to add the pass to their Apple Wallet or Google Wallet. By default, the `{contactId}` path segment is the numeric Brevo contact ID. To generate an installation URL from a contact's `EXT_ID` attribute (typically an identifier from your own CRM or database) instead, set the `byExtId` query parameter to `true` — the `{contactId}` path segmen…
preconditions: A valid Brevo API key authorized for this resource.
The resource identified by the path parameters must exist; otherwise the API returns 404.

passId.description: Pass ID. The unique identifier of the wallet pass for which to generate an installation URL.

contactId.description: Contact identifier the installation URL is generated for. Interpretation depends on the `byExtId` query parameter: - When `byExtId` is absent or `false` (default), this must be the numeric Brevo contact ID (positive integer). - When `byExtId=true`, this must be the URL-encoded v…

byExtId.description: When set to `true`, the `{contactId}` path segment is interpreted as the contact's `EXT_ID` attribute value rather than the numeric Brevo contact ID. Any value other than `true` (including absent, empty, `false`, `1`) keeps the default numeric behaviour.

url.description: The wallet installation URL for the contact. Opening it lets the contact add the pass to their Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.

errors.meaning: Invalid path parameters. Returned when `passId` is not a well-formed UUID, when `contactId` is missing, when `byExtId` is absent/`false` and `contactId` is not a positive integer, or when `byExtId=true` and the provided `EXT_ID` value is empty after trimming.
The pass does not belong to the authenticated account.
Not found. Returned when the pass does not exist, or when `byExtId=true` and no contact in the authenticated account has an `EXT_ID` attribute matching the provided value.

Ambiguous `EXT_ID`. Returned only when `byExtId=true` and more than one contact in the authenticated account shares the provided `EXT_ID`. Ensure `EXT_ID` values are unique per account before retrying.
Wallet is not enabled for this account. The response `code` is `WALLET_NOT_ENABLED`.
Internal error occurred. Includes transient failures while resolving the contact by `EXT_ID`; the request can be retried.

This issues a `wallet_pass_scanned` event that can trigger automations and update contact segments (for example to track store visits, event attendance or loyalty check-ins).
